```
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium that retains the viability of the embryos; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water that does not harm the viability of the embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme that degrades cell walls.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos that retain viability during analysis.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a quiescent state prior to step (c) or (d).

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping using PCR-based techniques.
```
